decisions.reason: The source changes the operational demonstration criteria; the bowl markings are separately deferred by the same message and require no value or scope modification.
The demonstration criteria do not change the lighting design. Possible lighting and later cosmetic work are handled by the candidate's existing DEFER Event.
Requiring a demonstration under normal operating conditions does not alter the completed-layout, CAD-format, or CAD-retention obligations.
The source prioritizes functional demonstration but does not revise the decorative-control specifications; their postponement is already represented by the same-message DEFER Event.
The operational demonstration criteria do not modify the power-button lighting design, and the aesthetic feature is already deferred by the same source message.
The source does not change the BOM deliverable, selected components, or compatibility requirements.
The reference to finishing outstanding wiring concerns prototype construction after evaluation and does not modify the existing wiring-plan deliverable.
Stability becomes an evaluation criterion for the demonstration, but the underlying structural-stability behavior and scope remain unchanged.
The demonstration modification does not revise the back-panel design or font; later handling of cosmetic work is already represented by the candidate's DEFER Event.
The source does not change any base-logo values. Its postponement of further branding is already represented by the same-message DEFER Event.
The operational demonstration criteria do not alter the Deck 1 and Deck 2 label specifications, which are already deferred by the same source message.
Mixing performance is named as something to assess during the demonstration, but the required mixing, foam, whisk, and high-speed behavior remain unchanged.
